name: claim-replay
description: Replay a golden set of pharmacy claims through a new adjudication rule or plan configuration before it goes live: rule-level diffs, latency budgets, and a CI gate.
author: Vinod Kumar G

scripts.replay: node src/cli.ts replay --release releases/2026-11-pgx.json --golden golden --out reports
scripts.replay:fixed: node src/cli.ts replay --release releases/2026-11-pgx-fixed.json --golden golden --out reports
scripts.demo: npm run record && (npm run replay || true) && npm run replay:fixed
